meta.name: list-growth-designer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "grow my email list", "design a lead magnet / signup incentive", "set up double opt-in", or "plan a referral / recommendation loop"; produces a list-growth plan — acquisition channels, lead-magnet / incentive concepts, a compliant double-opt-in capture-flow spec, referral-loop mechanics, and subscriber-growth / cost-per-opt-in targets (labeled Estimated) — that feeds SEND-S (consent quality captured at acquisition) and SEND-N (lifecycle entry). Not for the signup page/popup UX itself — use landing-optimizer; not for recording the opt-in — use consent-registry; not for the confirmation-email copy — use email-creative-builder. 邮件列表增长/lead magnet/双重确认/推荐环

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定邮件列表增长计划，包括获取渠道和激励设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想通过邮件列表获取更多订阅者并提升转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Create an email list growth plan with acquisition channels and incentive design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to grow your email list and improve subscriber acquisition.

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你制定邮件列表增长计划，包括获取渠道、免费赠品/激励概念、合规的双重确认流程、推荐循环机制，以及订阅者增长和每次确认成本的目标。它只做策略规划，不设计注册页面或写确认邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求“增长我的邮件列表”、“设计一个免费赠品/注册激励”、“设置双重确认”或“规划推荐循环”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个针对创业者的免费电子书作为注册激励。
say.note: 技能会输出免费赠品概念和获取渠道建议。

say.text: 为我的新闻通讯设置一个双重确认流程，地区是欧盟。
say.note: 技能会生成合规的确认流程规格。

say.text: 规划一个推荐循环，当前列表有5000人，主要来自博客。
say.note: 技能会设计推荐机制和增长目标。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you create an email list growth plan: acquisition channels, lead magnet/incentive concepts, a compliant double opt-in capture flow, referral loop mechanics, and subscriber growth/cost-per-opt-in targets. It only designs strategy, not signup pages or confirmation emails.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "grow my email list", "design a lead magnet/signup incentive", "set up double opt-in", or "plan a referral/recommendation loop".

say_en.text: Design a lead magnet (free ebook) for entrepreneurs as a signup incentive.
say_en.note: Outputs lead magnet concept and channel suggestions.

say_en.text: Set up a double opt-in flow for my newsletter, jurisdiction EU.
say_en.note: Generates a compliant capture flow spec.

say_en.text: Plan a referral loop for my 5000-subscriber list from blog.
say_en.note: Designs referral mechanics and growth targets.
